title: Strict local rings after a quotient base change
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal, $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $Z=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ with projection $i:Z\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $\Omega$ be algebraically closed and $\bar z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Z$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $\bar w=i\bar z$ and $H=\mathcal O^{sh}_{X,\bar w}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. The structural morphism $\operatorname{Spec}H\to X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ gives $\alpha:A\to H$. There is a canonical ring isomorphism $H/\alpha(I)H\simeq\mathcal O^{sh}_{Z,\bar z}$ whose composite with the quotient map equals the ring map induced by strict-henselization functoriality [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality].

proof.text: The base change of a quotient spectrum is a closed immersion. The closed-immersion strict-localization comparison identifies Spec of the strict local ring of Z with Z times_X Spec H, through the lift whose second leg is the canonical strict-local morphism.

Apply the affine quotient-base-change model to the affine morphism Spec H to X (the model does not require an open immersion). Compose the two scheme isomorphisms. Full faithfulness of Spec gives the ring equivalence in the opposite direction. The affine projection equation and the second projection of the lift identify the composite with the quotient map with the prescribed functorial ring map.

lean.statement:
theorem quotient_base_change_strict_local_ring {X : Scheme.{u}} (A : CommRingCat.{u})
    (p : X ⟶ Spec A) (I : Ideal A)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) :
    ∃ e : (strictHenselizationRing (z ≫ pullback.fst _ _) ⧸
        Ideal.map (Spec.preimage
          (strictHenselizationStructuralMap (z ≫ pullback.fst _ _) ≫ p)).hom I) ≃+*
        strictHenselizationRing z,
      e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) =
        (Spec.preimage (strictHenselizationMap (pullback.fst _ _) z)).hom
